The question asks who served as governor in the state where the deadliest battle of the US Civil War occurred, twenty-three years later. The ground truth answer is "Robert E Pattison." The predicted answer identifies the battle as Antietam in Maryland (fought in 1862), and claims that Henry Lloyd was governor of Maryland in 1885. Robert E Pattison was indeed governor of Pennsylvania in 1886 (which is close to 23 years after 1863), matching the ground truth.
